The decks are then shuffled (103.3) and the hands drawn (103.5); both keep (implied). Each deck has nine cards, not eight: A draws on turns 3 and 5 and B on turns 2 and 4, and with eight cards a seat would draw from an empty library and lose (104.3c, 704.5b). B plays a Forest on each of its turns, since an eighth card in hand at B's cleanup would force a recorded discard (514.1). On turn 5, A plays its third Plains and takes the companion special action (116.2g, 702.139a), paying {3}: Lurrus moves from outside the game into A's hand. Draws: A draws lionsA2 on turn 3 and lionsA3 on turn 5 (A skips the turn-1 draw, 103.8a); B draws forestB8 on turn 2 and forestB9 on turn 4.
